objective: Audit and fix primary concurrent Gemini/Vobiz calls, bulk campaigns, campaign UX, responsive UI, backend/website security and technical SEO
acceptance_criteria: Primary campaign create/start/pause/resume/call execution traced through auth, tenant scopes, contact claims, concurrency capacity and completion
Confirmed duplicate-dial/concurrency/retry/cancellation faults fixed with isolated race/failure tests
Campaign setup uses fewer steps and preserves consent, validation and clear launch errors
Campaign flow and main website/console layouts verified at mobile/tablet/desktop sizes with keyboard and overflow checks
Auth, tenant access, uploads, URL fetching, rendering, webhooks, headers and dependency/secret surfaces reviewed and confirmed findings fixed
Public pages have consistent crawlable routing, canonical metadata, robots and sitemap; authenticated pages excluded from indexing
SAST/security regressions and available isolated DAST tools run with incomplete coverage reported explicitly
boundaries: No production changes, data migrations, destructive data changes or billing-rate changes
No real customer calls, campaign launches or integration writes
Use primary Gemini/Vobiz flow; secondary provider flows are outside functional call audit
No claim of unlimited scale, legal compliance, guaranteed rankings or zero vulnerabilities
New external-URL scans require an explicitly authorized staging target; otherwise use isolated localhost
